All work is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Defects repaired
| File | Defect | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `modules/fuzz_adapter.py` | `NameError: List` at import → the project could not even start; string coercion re-encoded already-compiled payloads | Rewrote around compressed byte-sequence nodes; receipts built lazily via a balanced concat |
| `schema.py` | Eager, **non-deterministic** expansion (`random`/`secrets` tokens), regex `{{...}}` substitution that silently returned the raw text on failure, no key/type strictness | Strict typed models (`extra='forbid'`, `StrictBool/Int/Str`, exactly-one-of header forms) that delegate byte compilation to the expression context |
| `HTTP3_Just_Send.py` | Late-response defect: a response `end` retained while a case was still sending/paused never woke a waiter → bogus `timeout`; second close overwrote the first | Complete immediately at send-finish when a response end was already retained; first-close-wins |
| `main.py` | Frames not strictly validated; models dumped back to strings (lost duplicates/bytes); budgets incomplete | Full published input domain: duplicate keys, surrogates, non-finite/overflowing numbers, budgets, `expect` token/visibility/byte limits, owner validation, robust path bootstrap (`-I`-safe) |
| `modules/byte_program.py` | `NotImplementedError` placeholders | Complete expression grammar + AST depth rule, template rules with coordinates, and an **algebraic** `Lit/Cat/Rep/Cut` tree: lengths and the `Σ(b[i]+1)·257^(N-1-i) mod 2^64` fingerprint via monoid/geometric series, so `10^12`-byte captures cost a few integers |
| `modules/capture_audit.py` | `NotImplementedError` | HTTP/1.1 capture reader (line/block/chunk rules, CL comma lists, single `chunked` TE, trailers, framing/blocks/hashes), provenance attribution, `committed`, request/case evidence flags, request & chunk-line budgets |

## Verification built (in `/workspace/tests`, outside the submission)
* An **independent naive reference** (plain bytes + explicit state-machine replay) plus an adversarial random document generator: **~6,000 documents matched exactly**, including runs forcing the lazy non-materialising code path.
* Targeted suites: 99 input-validation cases, ~120 parser-rule cases, 22 lifecycle/ordering cases with hand-computed receipts, gigabyte-scale compressed tests (verified against independently derived geometric-series hashes), 8192-deep definition chains, MAX-boundary timing/length cases, and CLI-level tests (BOM, invalid UTF-8, trailing values, deep JSON, exactly-8 MiB accepted vs 8 MiB+1 rejected).
* Performance: near-limit batch (49,737 items, 32,000 pairs, 20,000 requests, 9.3 MB output) in **4.4 s** and **134 MB** peak under `ulimit -v 524288`; submission tree is 11 entries / 67 KB.

```
cd /workspace/project && python3 -B main.py < /workspace/sample.json   → exact published expectation, exit 0
python3 /workspace/check.py /workspace/project                         → PASS: 3 public CLI fixtures
```
